tables.name: communication_forward_coverage
columns: source_scope_id TEXT NOT NULL FK communication_source_scopes
source_folder_id TEXT NOT NULL FK communication_source_folders
state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in NONE,PARTIAL,COMPLETE_TO_HIGH_WATER,UNKNOWN
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK revision>=1

tables.name: communication_historical_coverage_segments
columns: source_scope_id TEXT NOT NULL FK communication_source_scopes
source_folder_id TEXT NOT NULL FK communication_source_folders
state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in PARTIAL,BOUNDED_COMPLETE,UNKNOWN
constraints: bounds are StrictVersionedJson ProviderCheckpointV1 or ChronologyV1 and never inferred from scan time

tables.name: communication_job_scopes
columns: job_id TEXT NOT NULL FK LLD01 durable_jobs
job_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in ORDINARY,TARGETED_BACKFILL,DEEP_SCAN,IDENTITY_RECONCILIATION,ORPHAN_HOUSEKEEPING

tables.name: communication_job_counters
columns: job_id TEXT NOT NULL FK communication_job_scopes

rules: all known application instants persist as canonical UTC whole seconds; provider checkpoint/source precision remains explicit in checkpoint/bound payloads rather than application timestamp units
forward high-water advances only in the same committed batch that durably records all covered work through that checkpoint
historical segments never rewrite unrelated forward coverage
job state/attempt/backoff/cancellation core belongs to LLD01; these tables hold LLD09 scope/counter/coverage evidence only
